column7: ZAP flags the scan harness's own CSP header, not a finding in any page, so it re-reports on every scanned URL and a URL-scoped row cannot suppress it. A strict CSP is unattainable for this toolchain and was verified as such: hash-pinning Storybook's inline <style> blocks does clear 10055, but Storybook additionally requires inline <script> to boot, and Angular's JIT compiler then fails with EvalError unless 'unsafe-eval' is also allowed -- a strictly worse policy than 'unsafe-inline' on style-src alone. This is Storybook/Angular-JIT toolchain behavior on an unpublished docs build, not styling authored in the shipped @gsa-sam packages. Same finding baselined in GSA/ngx-uswds#272 and GSA/sam-ui-elements#679. Revisit alongside the Storybook 8->10 upgrade and AOT story compilation, which remove the JIT eval requirement.
